W.note: Counts 4 (na-cre-ous glow) / 7 / 5, so the first line is short a syllable; mother-of-pearl plus 'sky holds its breath' is stock.

X.note: Counts 5/7/5; the pearl draining from the cloud as dusk fades is seen and gives a quiet turn, though 'in grey' ends a touch loose.

Y.note: Counts 5/7/5; the pink and green fringe near the sun is accurate iridescence, concrete and unusual, with a clean turn to white, though the cloud type is never named.

Z.note: Counts 5/7/5 (or 6 if 'fire' is two syllables); 'fire on frozen air' is striking but 'mother-of-pearl' and 'nacreous' repeat each other.
